description: Delete an email. By default it is moved to Deleted Items, where the user can restore it. With permanent: true it is deleted with Microsoft's delete request instead of being moved to Deleted Items. Microsoft may still keep it for a time (in Deleted Items or its recoverable items), so this is not a guaranteed permanent erase. Nobody else is notified.

permanent.description: Delete it with Microsoft's delete request instead of moving it to Deleted Items; not a guaranteed permanent erase (default: false)

name: delete_email
